faq.a1: Yes. We only use your public UID to reconcile fees with the exchange — no API keys, and we never touch your funds. Your trading account stays fully under your control.
faq.q2: Where does the cashback money come from?
faq.a2: From the same referral pool exchanges already pay to YouTubers and Telegram admins. MaxBack is an official exchange partner, receives that commission and passes most of it back to you — the person who generated it.
faq.q3: How is this different from a referral code?
faq.a3: A referral code gives you a one-time discount while commission keeps flowing to the code owner. MaxBack returns up to 90% of your trading fees, in USDT, every day, indefinitely.
faq.q4: What if I already have an exchange account?
faq.a4: New accounts earn cashback from the first trade. For existing accounts, whether attribution can be moved depends on each exchange's policy — contact support to check your options.
faq.a5: You can withdraw once your balance reaches 10 USDT. Payouts are sent in USDT to your exchange wallet and processed automatically every day.
faq.q6: What if I find a higher rate?
faq.a6: Best Cashback Guarantee: find somewhere paying more, tell us, and we cover the difference under the conditions published in the Help Center.
